user.title: EasyTouch over RS-485
user.description: How does your RS-485 bridge (for example an Elfin EW11) talk on the network?

menu_options.connect: Home Assistant connects to the bridge (bridge in TCP server mode)
menu_options.listen: The bridge connects to Home Assistant (bridge in TCP client mode)

connect.title: Bridge address
connect.description: Address of the bridge wired to the EasyTouch.

data.read_only: Listen only (never send anything to the controller)

data_description.read_only: Leave this on while njsPC is still running. Turn it off in the options when this integration takes over.

listen.title: Let the bridge connect
listen.description: Point the bridge's TCP client at this Home Assistant's IP address and the port below. Setup waits up to a minute for it to dial in.

data.read_only: Listen only (never send anything to the controller)

data_description.read_only: Leave this on for the first install. Turn it off in the options when this integration takes over.

error.no_status: No status broadcast from the EasyTouch arrived. Check the bridge address or where the bridge points, the port, and the RS-485 wiring.
error.port_in_use: Something on this Home Assistant is already using that port.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up

data.power_threshold: Running if power is at least (W)
data.pump_circuits: Circuits the pool pump switch turns on together

data_description.schedule_mode: Home Assistant: HA switches the pump and the controller keeps no schedules. Controller: HA writes the schedules into the controller and verifies them, and the controller runs the pump on its own.
data_description.power_entity: Optional. When it's reporting, a high-speed relay that's on with no motor draw shows the pool pump as off.
data_description.summer_months: Months that use the summer weekday/weekend times, e.g. 4-10
data_description.source_addr: Leave at 33 unless another remote uses it.
data_description.pump_circuits: Circuit numbers in the order to turn on (off goes in reverse). Usually just 6 (Pool). A two-speed pump wired to the high-speed relay needs Pool and High Speed, e.g. 6, 2.
data_description.circuit_names: Optional number:name pairs to override the panel's names, e.g. 2:Pump High Speed, 3:Lights

error.bad_circuits: Enter one or more circuit numbers, e.g. 6 or 6, 2

schedule_sync_failed.title: Pool controller schedules aren't in sync
schedule_sync_failed.description:
Writing the pump schedule to the EasyTouch didn't stick: {error}

It retries every 5 minutes. Check the controller link and the panel.
